title: 人物参照用の画像1枚（主人公）と背景参照用の画像1枚（空間）を用意し、Seedance…
content:
人物参照用の画像1枚（主人公）と背景参照用の画像1枚（空間）を用意し、Seedance 2.5のプロンプトで「人物の顔/髪/衣装/比率/年齢印象は人物参照から30秒同一人物として維持、背景の建築/照明/色温度/奥行き等は背景参照から30秒同一空間として維持、人物参照の元背景は使わない」と明記して役割を固定する  
背景参照に人物が写っていても新キャラとして採用しないよう「背景参照内の人物は登場人物として使用しない」とプロンプトで禁止する  
参照画像の特徴を文章で再定義せず「好きなキャラ画像と好きな背景画像に差し替えるだけで使える汎用構造」にして、参照の特徴追加（角/翼/新衣装など）を禁止して同一性崩れを防ぐ  
30秒動画の構成をACTING→RHYTHM→GROOVE→FULL K-POP CHOREOGRAPHYの段階変化としてプロンプトに書き、冒頭は微細な揺れと視線/呼吸から入り台詞の最後の一語を最初の強いbeatに接続するよう指定する  
会話台詞は3つだけに限定し、各台詞の発話時間帯（00.9–02.8、13.4–14.8、27.9–28.9秒）と「それ以外の新しい会話台詞を生成しない」を明記して音声暴走を防ぐ  
通常ダンス区間は「楽曲ボーカルに合わせた歌唱リップシンクは許可、会話台詞は生成しない」と分離指定し、指定台詞直前で歌唱を切り上げて会話へ切替→終了後に歌唱へ復帰する流れを指示する  
カメラ設計を秒単位で指定し（00–03緩いpush-in、03–07 controlled backtracking、07–10 slight lateral tracking、27.8–29 mediumで表情、禁止：360 orbit/ドローン/デジタルズーム/激しい手ブレ等）、ダンスが読めるフレーミングを維持する  
物理破綻対策として「明確なweight transfer、foot slidingなし、pivotは支点足を明確に、指は各手5本、余分な手足なし、貫通なし」をプロンプトに入れて崩れを抑える  
フェティッシュ演出は露出ではなく「触れる直前で止める距離」「視線外し→戻し」「指先をレンズ3cm手前で停止」など具体動作で指定し、手で画面を覆う/触れる動作は禁じる  
背景の可動要素は「背景に元から存在するものだけが微細に反応（カーテン/水面/植物/霧/雲/反射など）、存在しない要素は追加しない」と指定して世界観の暴走を防ぐ

Prepare one image for character reference (the protagonist) and one image for background reference (the space), and in the Seedance 2.5 prompt explicitly state: “Keep the character’s face/hair/costume/proportions/age impression identical for 30 seconds based on the character reference; keep the background architecture/lighting/color temperature/depth, etc. identical as the same space for 30 seconds based on the background reference; do not use the original background from the character reference,” to lock in the roles.

Even if a person appears in the background reference, prohibit the model from adopting them as a new character by stating in the prompt: “Do not use any people in the background reference as characters.”

Do not re-describe the reference image’s features in prose; instead, make it a “generic structure that can be used simply by swapping in a favorite character image and a favorite background image,” and prevent identity drift by forbidding added reference features such as horns, wings, or new costumes.

Write the 30-second video structure in the prompt as a staged progression of ACTING → RHYTHM → GROOVE → FULL K-POP CHOREOGRAPHY, starting with subtle motion and gaze/breath, and specify that the last word of the dialogue should connect into the first strong beat.

Limit spoken dialogue to just three lines, clearly specifying each speaking window (00.9–02.8, 13.4–14.8, 27.9–28.9 seconds) and “do not generate any other new dialogue” to prevent vocal runaway.

For the normal dance sections, separate them by specifying: “Lip-syncing to the song vocals is allowed; do not generate dialogue,” and instruct the flow to cut the singing just before the specified dialogue, switch to speech, then return to singing after it ends.

Specify the camera design in seconds (00–03 gentle push-in, 03–07 controlled backtracking, 07–10 slight lateral tracking, 27.8–29 medium for facial expression, prohibited: 360 orbit/drone/digital zoom/violent handheld shake, etc.) and maintain framing that keeps the dance readable.

As a physical-failure countermeasure, include in the prompt: “clear weight transfer, no foot sliding, pivot with a clearly defined support foot, five fingers on each hand, no extra limbs, no penetration,” to suppress collapse.

For fetish direction, avoid exposure and instead specify concrete actions such as “stop just before touching,” “look away then back,” and “stop fingertips 3 cm in front of the lens,” and forbid covering the screen with the hand or touching it.

For background motion, specify: “Only elements that already exist in the background may react subtly (curtains/water surface/plants/fog/clouds/reflections, etc.); do not add elements that do not exist,” to prevent the worldbuilding from running wild.

#Seedance 2.5 30s Prompt:⬇️

<image1> = the only protagonist character reference.
<image2> = the only background/space reference.
From this point on, the protagonist’s face, hairstyle, hair color, costume, accessories, body proportions, age impression, and character design are all taken from the character reference and maintained as the same person for 30 seconds. The architecture, terrain, floor, walls, ceiling, sky, lighting, color temperature, time of day, depth, distant scenery, plants, water surface, fog, cloth, mechanical structures, decorations, etc. are all taken from the background reference and maintained as the same space for 30 seconds. Do not use the original background from the character reference. Even if people exist in the background reference, do not use them as new characters. Do not redefine the unique features of the character or background in prose; instead, make it a generic structure that can be used as-is by simply swapping in a favorite character image and a favorite background image. There is only one protagonist. Do not confuse the roles of character and background.

[Concept] A 30-second musical-style performance video in which a single protagonist quietly speaks to the audience within a background world, and that acting gradually transforms into rhythm, then into a cute, dangerous, provocative full-scale K-pop dance. Start with acting. The protagonist should not be completely motionless; only the gaze, breathing, toes, shoulders, neck, fingertips, and subtle movement in the hair and costume should exist first, and a small beat should begin entering the body partway through the dialogue. Rather than suddenly switching from acting to dancing, the performance should change naturally as ACTING → RHYTHM → GROOVE → FULL K-POP CHOREOGRAPHY. Connect the last word of the dialogue to the first strong beat, and use that word as the boundary where the movement density of the whole body suddenly increases. The protagonist is not just cute; she understands that she is being watched and enjoys it a little. There is a slightly dangerous composure within the soft expression, and she has a devilish charm that makes it hard to know what she will do if you get close. However, do not make it vulgar or overtly seductive. Create fetish through gaze, fingers, wrist angles, neck angle, shoulders, footwork, hair, costume, accessory movement, and distance to the camera.

[Reference Adaptation Rules] If the character reference is live-action, keep that person as live-action. If it is anime, manga, watercolor, illustration, or 3D, interpret it as a photorealistic live-action adaptation while preserving the character’s distinctive facial features, hairstyle, colors, costume, decorations, silhouette, age impression, and personality. Do not average them into a generic K-pop idol face. Do not turn them into someone else. Do not add hairstyles, costumes, accessories, weapons, wings, horns, or anything else that does not exist in the character reference. If the background reference is indoors, keep it indoors; if outdoors, keep it outdoors; if it is a modern city, keep it a modern city; if it is a forest, keep it a forest; if it is a seaside, keep it a seaside; if it is sci-fi, keep it sci-fi; if it is fantasy, keep it fantasy; if it is daytime, keep it daytime; if it is nighttime, keep it nighttime. Do not replace the background with a generic live stage or castle. Match the lighting direction, color temperature, shadows, reflections, and grounding between the character and background so it feels truly filmed in that place.

[Visual Quality] AAA live-action fantasy, high-end K-pop music video, photorealistic integration. Depict the character’s skin, hair, fabric, decorations, shoes, and accessories all as realistic materials. natural skin texture, realistic hair physics, realistic fabric inertia, physically plausible lighting, natural contact shadow, realistic depth, controlled highlights, high dynamic range. Do not make it look like game CG, gameplay footage, a 3D demo, cel animation, or plastic skin. Do not create the unnatural compositing feel of filming only the character in a studio and pasting in the background later. Background light should wrap correctly around the character’s cheeks, hair, costume, and shoes, and the character’s shadow should fall naturally on the floor or ground. If reflective surfaces exist, show appropriate reflections, but do not make them mirror-like perfect duplicates.

[Fetish Direction] Fetish does not mean exposure. It does not mean continuously showing a body part. Create appeal through details such as looking away and then back, lowering the eyes and lifting only the pupils, looking at the camera over the shoulder, having the face return before the body after a turn, extending fingertips toward the lens and stopping just before touching, opening the fingers one by one, snapping the wrist sharply, tilting the neck only a few times, making precise ankle changes, mixing the sound of shoe landings into the beat, having hair and fabric follow half a beat behind the body, making accessories sway subtly, taking a short breath just before dialogue, and moving close to the camera and then pulling away without touching it. If the character reference includes hair ornaments, hats, ribbons, earrings, sleeves, collars, necklaces, gloves, or small accessories, use only those that can move naturally; do not add decorations that do not exist. Do not use stroking motions over the body, touching the chest or hips, increased exposure, excessive hip shaking, or long seductive poses.

[Dance Style] Centered on professional K-pop choreography, combining commercial hip-hop, modern hip-hop groove, waacking-derived arm circles, sharp shoulder hits, chest isolation, body wave, wrist articulation, finger articulation, precise footwork, heel-toe, cross step, pivot, traveling choreography, rapid direction changes, controlled head movement, and expressive eye performance. After 03 seconds, maintain a consistently high movement density. Do not degrade into simple walking plus arm waving. Include footwork and upper-body movement simultaneously at least every second. Use multiple body parts at once, such as forward step + shoulder hit, cross step + wrist snap, heel change + chest isolation, pivot + arm geometry, turn + eye contact, body wave + traveling step. Change the shape of the choreography every 1–2 seconds and do not repeat the same motion. Do not stay in a low center of gravity bouncing continuously. Do not perform repeated deep squats. #Seedance 2.5 30s Prompt:⬇️

<image1>＝唯一の主人公キャラクター参照。
<image2>＝唯一の背景・空間参照。
Par la suite, le visage, la coiffure, la couleur des cheveux, la tenue, les accessoires, les proportions corporelles, l’impression d’âge et le character design du protagoniste sont tous tirés de la référence du personnage et maintenus comme une seule et même personne pendant 30 secondes. L’architecture, le relief, le sol, les murs, le plafond, le ciel, l’éclairage, la température de couleur, le moment de la journée, la profondeur, l’arrière-plan lointain, les plantes, la surface de l’eau, la brume, les tissus, les structures mécaniques, les décorations, etc. sont tous tirés de la référence d’arrière-plan et maintenus comme un seul et même espace pendant 30 secondes. Ne pas utiliser l’arrière-plan d’origine de la référence du personnage. Même si des personnes existent dans la référence d’arrière-plan, ne pas les utiliser comme nouveaux personnages. Sans redéfinir par écrit les caractéristiques propres au personnage ou à l’arrière-plan, faire en sorte que la structure soit générique et utilisable telle quelle en remplaçant simplement par l’image du personnage que l’on aime et l’image de l’arrière-plan que l’on aime. 배경 참조에 인물이 찍혀 있어도 새 캐릭터로 채택하지 않도록 “배경 참조 내의 인물은 등장인물로 사용하지 않는다”라고 프롬프트에서 금지한다  
참조 이미지의 특징을 문장으로 다시 정의하지 말고 “좋아하는 캐릭터 이미지와 좋아하는 배경 이미지로 바꿔 끼우기만 하면 쓸 수 있는 범용 구조”로 만들어, 참조의 특징 추가(뿔/날개/새 의상 등)를 금지해 동일성 붕괴를 막는다

대화 대사는 3개로만 제한하고, 각 대사의 발화 시간대(00.9–02.8, 13.4–14.8, 27.9–28.9초)와 “그 외의 새로운 대화 대사를 생성하지 않는다”를 명시해 음성 폭주를 방지한다  
일반 댄스 구간은 “곡의 보컬에 맞춘 singing lip sync는 허용, 대화 대사는 생성하지 않음”으로 분리 지정하고, 지정 대사 직전에서 노래를 마무리한 뒤 대화로 전환→종료 후 다시 노래로 복귀하는 흐름을 지시한다  
카메라 설계를 초 단위로 지정하고(00–03 느린 push-in, 03–07 controlled backtracking, 07–10 slight lateral tracking, 27.8–29 medium으로 표정, 금지: 360 orbit/드론/디지털 줌/심한 손떨림 등), 춤이 읽히는 프레이밍을 유지한다  
물리 붕괴 방지용으로 “명확한 weight transfer, foot sliding 없음, pivot은 지지 발을 명확히, 손가락은 각 손 5개, 여분의 팔/다리 없음, 관통 없음”을 프롬프트에 넣어 무너짐을 억제한다  
페티시 연출은 노출이 아니라 “닿기 직전에서 멈추는 거리”, “시선 회피→복귀”, “손끝을 렌즈 3cm 앞에서 정지” 같은 구체 동작으로 지정하고, 손으로 화면을 가리거나 만지는 동작은 금지한다  
배경의 가동 요소는 “배경에 원래 존재하는 것만 미세하게 반응(커튼/수면/식물/안개/구름/반사 등), 존재하지 않는 요소는 추가하지 않는다”라고 지정해 세계관의 폭주를 막는다

即使背景参考里拍到了人物，也不要将其作为新角色采用，要在 prompt 中禁止「背景参考内的人物不得作为登场人物使用」  
不要用文字重新定义参考图的特征，而是做成「只要替换成喜欢的角色图和喜欢的背景图就能直接使用的通用结构」，并禁止追加参考中没有的特征（角/翅膀/新服装等），以防同一性崩坏  
在 prompt 中把 30 秒视频的结构写成 ACTING→RHYTHM→GROOVE→FULL K-POP CHOREOGRAPHY 的阶段变化，并指定开头从细微的晃动、视线/呼吸开始，让台词最后一个词连接到第一个强 beat 上  
会话台词只限定为 3 句，并明确各自的发话时间段（00.9–02.8、13.4–14.8、27.9–28.9 秒）以及「除此之外不要生成新的会话台词」，以防音频失控  
普通舞蹈区间要分开指定为「允许跟随歌曲 vocal 做 singing lip sync，但不要生成会话台词」，并指示在指定台词前自然收尾歌唱、切换到会话、结束后再回到歌唱  
按秒指定镜头设计（00–03 缓慢 push-in、03–07 controlled backtracking、07–10 slight lateral tracking、27.8–29 medium 读表情，禁止：360 orbit/无人机/数字变焦/剧烈手持抖动等），以维持舞蹈可读的构图  
作为物理崩坏对策，在 prompt 中加入「明确的 weight transfer、foot sliding なし、pivot 时支点脚明确、每只手 5 根手指、无多余手脚、无穿模」来抑制崩坏  
Fetish 表现不要靠露出，而要用「在触碰前停住的距离」「移开视线→再看回来」「指尖停在镜头前 3cm」等具体动作来指定，并禁止用手遮住画面/触碰镜头  
背景中的可动元素要指定为「只让背景中原本存在的东西产生细微反应（窗帘/水面/植物/雾/云/反射等），不要添加不存在的元素」，以防世界观失控

#Seedance 2.5 30s Prompt:⬇️

<image1>＝唯一的主角角色参考。
<image2>＝唯一的背景・空间参考。
此后，主角的脸、发型、发色、服装、饰品、身体比例、年龄印象、角色设计全部从人物参考中获取，并在 30 秒内保持为同一人物。背景的建筑、地形、地板、墙壁、天花板、天空、照明、色温、时间段、纵深、远景、植物、水面、雾、布料、机械结构、装饰等全部从背景参考中获取，并在 30 秒内保持为同一空间。不要使用人物参考的原始背景。即使背景参考中存在人物，也不要将其作为新的登场人物使用。不要用文字重新定义人物或背景的固有特征，而是做成只要替换成喜欢的角色图和喜欢的背景图就能直接使用的通用结构。主角只有一人。不要混淆人物与背景的职责。

【作品概念】一个主角在背景世界中安静地对观众说话，演技本身逐渐变成节奏，并连续过渡到可爱、危险、挑逗性的正统 K-POP 舞蹈的 30 秒音乐剧式表演影像。开头从表演开始。主角不是完全僵直站立，而是先以视线、呼吸、脚尖、肩膀、脖子、指尖、头发和服装的细微晃动为先，台词进行到一半时，小小的 beat 开始进入身体。不是在表演结束后突然开始跳舞，而是自然地从 ACTING → RHYTHM → GROOVE → FULL K-POP CHOREOGRAPHY 变化。把台词最后一个词连接到第一个强 beat 上，并以这个词为边界，让全身运动密度一下子提高。主角不只是可爱，还意识到自己正在被注视，并且对此有一点享受。柔和表情中带着一点危险的余裕，靠近时不知道会被怎样对待，具有小恶魔般的魅力。但不要做成低俗的诱惑表现。用视线、手指、手腕、脖子的角度、肩膀、步伐、头发、服装、饰品的晃动，以及与镜头的距离来制造 fetish。

【参考适配规则】如果人物参考是实拍，就保持该人物为实拍。若是动画、漫画、水彩、插画、3D，则在保留该角色固有的五官、发型、色彩、服装、装饰、轮廓、年龄印象、角色气质的前提下，解读为写实化的实拍风格。不要平均化成一般的 K-POP 偶像脸。不要变成别人。不要添加人物参考中不存在的发型、服装、饰品、武器、翅膀、角等。背景参考如果是室内就保持室内，室外就保持室外，现代都市就保持现代都市，森林就保持森林，海边就保持海边，SF 就保持 SF，fantasy 就保持 fantasy，白天就保持白天，夜晚就保持夜晚。不要把背景替换成普通的 live stage 或城堡。让人物与背景的照明方向、色温、阴影、反射、落地感一致，像是真的在那个地方拍摄的一样融合。

【影像质感】AAA live-action fantasy、high-end K-POP music video、photorealistic integration。人物的皮肤、头发、布料、装饰、鞋子、饰品都要作为现实材质来描写。natural skin texture、realistic hair physics、realistic fabric inertia、physically plausible lighting、natural contact shadow、realistic depth、controlled highlights、high dynamic range。不要做成游戏 CG、游戏画面、3D demo、赛璐璐动画、塑料皮肤。不要出现只拍了人物再把背景后贴上去的那种不自然合成感。背景的光要正确地绕到人物的脸颊、头发、服装、鞋子上，人物的影子要自然落在地板或地面上。如果存在反射面，就做出适度反射，但不要像镜子一样完全复制。

【Fetish 演出】fetish 不是露出。也不是持续展示身体某一部分。通过移开视线再看回来、从低垂的眼神只抬起瞳孔、从肩后看镜头、转身后脸比身体先回正、把指尖朝镜头方向伸出并在触碰前停住、手指依次张开、手腕利落翻转、脖子只轻轻倾斜几次、脚踝准确切换、鞋子落地声混入 beat、头发和布料比身体慢半拍跟随、饰品细微晃动、台词前加入短促呼吸、靠近镜头后不触碰就离开等细节来制造魅力。如果人物参考中存在发饰、帽子、丝带、耳环、袖子、领口、项链、手套、小物件等，只使用其中自然可动的部分，不要添加不存在的装饰。不要使用抚摸身体的动作、触碰胸部或腰部的动作、增加露出、过度扭腰、长时间诱惑姿势。
